A fire broke out at a factory in Delhi's Narela Industrial Area on Thursday (November 5, 2026), prompting the deployment of 10 fire tenders, officials said.
The fire was reported at 9.05 a.m., and initially seven fire units were rushed to the spot. Three more vehicles, including two water bowsers and one water tender, were pressed into service following a request from the officer in charge, the Delhi Fire Service said.
